import subprocess,re
out=subprocess.run(['readelf','-SW','whitespace_compiler'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
secs=[]
for line in out.splitlines():
    m=re.search(r'\[\s*\d+\]\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s',line)
    if m: secs.append((m.group(1),int(m.group(3),16),int(m.group(4),16),int(m.group(5),16)))
data=open('whitespace_compiler','rb').read()
def v2o(va):
    for name,addr,off,size in secs:
        if size and addr<=va<addr+size: return off+(va-addr),name
    return None,None
# stmp_0 at 0xddc500: 8 bytes ptr + 8 bytes len

ptr,len_=struct.unpack('<QQ',data[off:off+16])

o,s=v2o(ptr); print(repr(data[o:o+len_]))

print('stmp_1 ptr=%x len=%d'%(ptr2,len2))
o,s=v2o(ptr2); print(repr(data[o:o+len2]))
EOF"}
